cash_session_closing_check.name: cash_session_closing_check
cash_session_closing_check.value:
("cash_session"."status" = 'open' and "cash_session"."closed_at" is null and "cash_session"."counted_cash_xof" is null and "cash_session"."expected_cash_xof" is null and "cash_session"."difference_xof" is null)
    or ("cash_session"."status" in ('closed','validated') and "cash_session"."closed_at" is not null and "cash_session"."closed_by_user_id" is not null and "cash_session"."counted_cash_xof" is not null and "cash_session"."expected_cash_xof" is not null and "cash_session"."difference_xof" = "cash_session"."counted_cash_xof" - "cash_session"."expected_cash_xof")

cash_session_validation_check.name: cash_session_validation_check
cash_session_validation_check.value: ("cash_session"."status" = 'validated') = ("cash_session"."validated_at" is not null and "cash_session"."validated_by_user_id" is not null)

import_batch_counts_check.name: import_batch_counts_check
import_batch_counts_check.value: "import_batch"."row_count" between 0 and 1000 and "import_batch"."column_count" between 1 and 30 and "import_batch"."file_size" > 0

import_row_decision_source_check.name: import_row_decision_source_check
import_row_decision_source_check.value: ("import_row"."decision" is null) = ("import_row"."decision_source" is null) and ("import_row"."decision_source" is null or "import_row"."decision_source" in ('auto','user'))

import_row_applied_check.name: import_row_applied_check
import_row_applied_check.value: ("import_row"."status" = 'applied') = ("import_row"."applied_at" is not null) and ("import_row"."applied_at" is null) = ("import_row"."applied_variant_id" is null)

notification_preference_quiet_check.name: notification_preference_quiet_check
notification_preference_quiet_check.value: ("notification_preference"."quiet_start_minute" is null) = ("notification_preference"."quiet_end_minute" is null) and coalesce("notification_preference"."quiet_start_minute", 0) between 0 and 1439 and coalesce("notification_preference"."quiet_end_minute", 0) between 0 and 1439

notification_template_text_length.name: notification_template_text_length
notification_template_text_length.value:
char_length("notification_template"."title_fr") between 1 and 120 and char_length("notification_template"."title_en") between 1 and 120 and char_length("notification_template"."title_ar") between 1 and 120
    and char_length("notification_template"."body_fr") between 1 and 500 and char_length("notification_template"."body_en") between 1 and 500 and char_length("notification_template"."body_ar") between 1 and 500

opening_balance_party_check.name: opening_balance_party_check
opening_balance_party_check.value: ("opening_balance"."party_type" = 'customer' and "opening_balance"."customer_id" is not null and "opening_balance"."supplier_id" is null) or ("opening_balance"."party_type" = 'supplier' and "opening_balance"."supplier_id" is not null and "opening_balance"."customer_id" is null)

product_alias_length_check.name: product_alias_length_check
product_alias_length_check.value: char_length("product_alias"."alias") between 1 and 160 and char_length("product_alias"."normalized") between 1 and 160

promotion_discount_check.name: promotion_discount_check
promotion_discount_check.value:
("promotion_code"."kind" = 'discount' and (("promotion_code"."discount_percent" between 1 and 100 and "promotion_code"."discount_xof" is null) or ("promotion_code"."discount_xof" > 0 and "promotion_code"."discount_percent" is null)))
    or ("promotion_code"."kind" = 'access' and "promotion_code"."discount_percent" is null and "promotion_code"."discount_xof" is null and "promotion_code"."plan_id" is not null and "promotion_code"."grant_days" between 1 and 3650)
